timingPolicy.rounding: Raw evidence is retained to the millisecond. Reported durations are rounded to the nearest whole second and decimal minutes to two places. Rounded categories reconcile to rounded total elapsed time.

activeWorkReconstruction.cause: The result required a durable Founder-review artifact and proof that no implementation or production mutation occurred.
